title.wall_note: EXTERIOR WALLS 9" THK, INTERNAL PARTITIONS 4 1/2" THK (NOT CALLED OUT ON SKETCH - DERIVED FROM DIMENSION CLOSURE)

notes: ENTRY STEPS AT WEST END OF VERANDAH: LVL:+0'-6" AND LVL:+1'-0"
RAILING ALONG THE NORTH EDGE OF THE VERANDAH (NO WALL)
ELEVATION / VIEW REFERENCE MARKS ON SHEET: A (NORTH), B (WEST), C (SOUTH), D (EAST)
assumptions: No wall-thickness callout appears anywhere on the sketch. 9" exterior and 4 1/2" internal were DERIVED, not assumed at random: 8'-0" (Toilet) + 4 1/2" + 6'-3" (Foyer) + 4 1/2" + 8'-9" (Office) = 23'-9", and 13'-0" (Bedroom) + 4 1/2" + 10'-4.5" (Kitchen) = 23'-9" - the same inner span; adding 9" + 9" gives 25'-3", which is exactly the written Verandah length. The north-south stack closes the same way: 5'-0" + 4 1/2" + 11'-0" = 10'-0" + 4 1/2" + 6'-0" = 16'-4 1/2", so the Toilet/Bedroom row and the Office/Kitchen row both land on the verandah wall.

Overall building envelope is therefore 25'-3" (E-W) x 26'-7 1/2" (N-S) to outer faces. The 26'-7 1/2" is computed (9" + 6'-0" + 4 1/2" + 10'-0" + 9" + 8'-0" + 9") - no overall north-south dimension is written on the sketch.

No plot size is written and the compound line carries no dimensions. The plot 31'-6" x 30'-7 1/2" and the building's position in it (3'-3" west setback, 3'-0" east, 2'-0" south, 2'-0" north) were MEASURED off the sketch against the derived building width, not read.

The Foyer is written 6'-3" x 6'-0", but its 6'-0" depth does not reconcile with the Toilet (5'-0") + partition + Bedroom (11'-0") stack that shares the same two bounding walls. The 6'-3" width was honoured (it is required by the width closure); the depth was resolved to 5'-0" clear so the Foyer sits between the verandah wall and the bedroom wall. Reported size_label keeps the sketch's written 6'-0".

The sketch draws the Bedroom/Kitchen partition roughly in line with the Office's west wall, but the written dimensions (Bedroom 13'-0", Kitchen 10'-4.5") place it 1'-7 1/2" further west. The WRITTEN dimensions were used, because they close exactly against the 23'-9" inner span. This leaves a 1'-7 1/2" wide passage strip between the Bedroom's east wall and the Office's west wall, running from the Kitchen wall up into the Foyer - which is how the Kitchen and Bedroom doors are reached on the sketch.

Door and window widths and positions were MEASURED against the derived scale (approx. 41.2 px/ft horizontally, 36.6 px/ft vertically on the supplied raster), not read - no opening on the sketch carries a written size. Python/ImageMagick were unavailable in this session, so no cropped enlargements could be produced; measurements come from the full-size raster and carry roughly +/- 3" uncertainty.
D4 (Office to Kitchen) is drawn hard against the Office's west wall, so its pos places it hard against that partition rather than centred.
D1 is the main entrance from the Verandah into the Foyer; D2 is a second door from the Verandah into the Office. Both are drawn as brown leaves in the verandah wall.
D5 is the Bedroom door, read as a 3'-0" leaf in the Bedroom's east wall opening off the Foyer/passage. This is the only door drawn on the Bedroom.
Tags W1, W2, W3 and V3 are the only opening tags written. No D-tags are written on the sketch - D1 to D5 were assigned by me, west to east / north to south.

The 'stair' recorded is the entrance step block at the west end of the Verandah, not a floor-to-floor flight. Two treads are drawn, labelled LVL:+0'-6" and LVL:+1'-0", climbing eastward onto the Verandah at LVL:+1'-6" - so three 6" risers in total but only two treads on plan. Its 1'-11" x 7'-3" extent was measured, not written.
The Verandah's north side is a railing and its west side is the step entry, so no wall is listed on either; its east and south sides are drawn as walls and are listed.
No project name, plan title, drawing number, revision or date appears on the sheet; title fields are left blank except plan_name.
